headline: Volume-led growth offset by opex and cash-flow pressure
summary_short: Net sales grew 2.8% y/y to $9,610M on 1.4% case-volume growth, and Adjusted EBITDA rose 6.2% to $413M, while operating cash flow fell 24.8% y/y to $294M on higher tax payments.
summary_long: Net sales rose 2.8% y/y to $9,610M on 1.4% case-volume growth (independent restaurant +4.6%) and 1.0% food inflation. Gross profit grew 2.4% to $1,653M despite a $38M LIFO drag; margin held near 17.2%. Operating income fell 3.6% to $216M as opex rose 3.4% on higher distribution and admin costs. Adjusted EBITDA rose 6.2% to $413M (4.3% margin); net income edged up to $116M on an 18% tax rate. Operating cash flow fell to $294M and Free Cash Flow to $197M on higher tax payments. US Foods repurchased $125M of stock; equity closed at $4,333M and cash at $49M. No forward guidance was issued.

drivers.explanation: Volume-led revenue and margin growth was partly offset by opex inflation, a LIFO cost headwind, and higher tax payments that pressured cash generation this quarter.
Net sales rose $259M on 1.4% total case-volume growth (independent restaurant +4.6%, healthcare +3.7%, hospitality +5.0%) and 1.0% food-cost inflation, partly offset by a 2.3% chain-volume decline.
Gross profit grew on higher case volume and improved cost of goods sold, partly offset by a $33M unfavorable y/y LIFO swing ($38M LIFO expense vs $5M a year ago).
Operating income fell as opex grew 3.4% on higher distribution, selling and administrative costs, only partly offset by distribution productivity gains and admin cost-streamlining.
Net income edged up as an 18% effective tax rate (vs 22% a year ago) offset the decline in operating income.
EPS grew faster than net income because weighted diluted shares fell about 5% y/y (234M to 223M) from ongoing share repurchases.
Operating cash flow fell $97M y/y on changes in operating assets and liabilities, including higher tax payments this quarter.
Capex rose on continued investment in information technology, property and equipment, and distribution-facility improvements.
